description: She wears a muted burgundy full-length gown with a low square neckline, fitted paneled bodice and elbow-length sleeves. Narrow gold-and-brown woven borders outline the neckline, straps, cuffs, central skirt panel and hem. A slim decorated belt has several round metal ornaments and a short hanging front tail. A beige-and-gold patterned wrap with burgundy lining rests around the forearms and falls beside the skirt. Small metal earrings, a pendant necklace and rings are visible. Brown closed shoes show beneath the long hem. Fabrics look opaque and textured, consistent with a woven court dress; exact fiber content is uncertain. Upper chest and forearms show while torso and pelvis remain clothed.
